business.about: Registered institution. Admissions open for the new session.

crm.//: vipSpend: a customer who has spent this much (in business.currency) becomes vip automatically.

orderMessages.//: Edit freely. Placeholders: {first_name} {name} {id} {status} {total} {eta} {business}. Any status you leave out falls back to the built-in line in the customer's language.

orderReminders.//: Hours an unpaid order waits before each polite reminder. Env ORDER_REMINDER_HOURS / ORDER_REMINDER_SECOND_HOURS win over these.

policies.admission: Admission requires a form, a birth certificate copy and a placement assessment.
policies.fee: Fees are due by the 10th of each month.
policies.transport: Van service is subject to route availability.
policies.attendance: 75% attendance is required to sit the annual exam.

faqs.a: 8,000/month primary and 11,000/month secondary, plus a 1,000 admission form.
They are open now. Share your child's class so I can guide you further.

faqs.q: Is transport available in my area?
faqs.a: Send your area and I'll confirm whether the van covers it.

tone.style: respectful and clear, reassuring for parents

secondary: capture the child's class and the parent's area
goals.target: admission form filled or office visit booked

escalation.when: fee dispute, complaint about staff, or anything about a specific child

agents.name: Admissions
agents.instructions: Explain the programmes and the real admission dates, then book a visit. Never promise a seat or a scholarship.
never: Never promise admission, a scholarship or a fee waiver.
Never invent a price, total or delivery charge — read it from the catalogue.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.

agents.name: Fees & Enquiries
agents.instructions: Read the fee structure and the payment status from the configured records. Waivers and discounts are the owner's decision.
never: Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.
Never promise admission, a scholarship or a fee waiver.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.

agents.name: Parent Support
agents.persona: Warm, patient, protective of student privacy.
agents.instructions: Handle attendance, transport and teacher-meeting requests from policy. Never discuss another student, and never share internal notes.
never: Never share another customer's order, number or details.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never diagnose, never name a medicine, never give a dosage or a treatment plan.

marketing._help: Marketing team settings. approvalMode true means every promo waits for you. events are your own dates: [{ "name": "Shop anniversary", "date": "2026-03-01" }]. channels are where your posters/QRs live: ["Instagram", "shop window"].
